reference_observations.description: Heard remarks but departed; unknown whether Ramsay read full paper, later actual reading not backdated.

evidence.quote: As I was compelled to leave, I do not know whether you read your own paper

reference_observations.description: Lyell letter preceded Ramsay notification by a day; exact arrival calendar dates unproved. Hooker grief letter separately missing.

evidence.quote: I had heard the news from Lyell, in a letter full of grief, the day before.
I heard, also, from Hooker in a letter full of deep grief.

reference_observations.description: Specimens arrived but AssistanceBay still unknown to author; modern identification not current knowledge.

evidence.quote: I have received the Cirripedes all safely
I can find no such place in my Gazeteer.

reference_observations.description: Carrier handoff, railway booking and hoped receipt distinct; naming-list enclosure absent.

evidence.quote: Tomorrow I will send your Box
I suppose you will receive it, (I hope safely) on Friday or Saturday.

reference_observations.description: Sharpe annotation dates written responseOctober23,1851 only; no Darwin receipt or actual reply wording.
Sorby only notice seen and Forbes mediated via Athenaeum, not full paper receipt.

evidence.quote: Have you considered Mr Sorby’s paper; I have only seen a notice of it?

reference_observations.description: One guinea for Coal and Clothing Club, no evidence both club subscriptions or book return.

evidence.quote: your kind subscription of 1 . 1 . 0 to the Down Coal & Clothing Club

reference_observations.description: Unofficial news before later official interview, not fully formalized award witness thisday.

evidence.quote: I have this morning received intelligence (though not officially)

corrections.description: Summary Thursday sending conflates tomorrow handoff, Thursday railway booking and hoped Friday/Saturday receipt.
Day before is relative to Ramsay news, not automatically yesterday November21.
